customManagers.description: Images pinned inside HelmRelease values, which no built-in manager reads. Annotate the line above the tag with `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>`.

Full image references under an `imageName:` key, as CNPG's Cluster CR uses. The built-in kubernetes manager only reads `image:`, and the tag-only manager above cannot split a repository from its tag. Annotate the line above with `# renovate: datasource=docker`.

packageRules.description: Talos itself (talos/, router/) is deliberately out of scope - version bumps there need the etcd-backup + one-node-at-a-time + health-check process documented in talos/README.md, not an automated PR. Kept explicit even though managerFilePatterns above already excludes these paths by only matching clusters/, as a second line of defense if that scoping ever changes.

immich's image tag is set via a bare `tag:` sub-field (no `repository:` alongside it) in release.yaml - the custom regex manager only captures that tag, so there's no digest sub-field for Renovate to populate. Matches the upstream example's own reasoning for the same exclusion.
